title: TeslaCANModder IO Schema
description: Unified schema for all firmware IO: serial/BLE newline-delimited JSON and WiFi REST API. Serial and BLE share an identical command/response protocol. WiFi exposes a separate REST surface with a different (native-bool) JSON state shape.

serial.description: USB CDC UART — newline-delimited JSON. Commands are plain text strings terminated with \n. Responses are one JSON object per line.

ble.description: Bluetooth Low Energy — Nordic UART Service (NUS). Same command/response protocol as serial.
ble.notes: Device name is set by BLE_DEVICE_NAME build constant. Enabled by BOARD_ENABLE_BLE. Numeric booleans 0/1 same as serial.

wifi.description: HTTP REST API served by the ESP32 in AP or STA mode. Booleans are native JSON true/false (not 0/1 integers).

auth.description: Required only for write endpoints (POST /cmd). Read endpoints are unauthenticated.

endpoints.description: Execute a firmware command. Same command vocabulary as serial/BLE. Returns updated state after the command executes.

errors.reason: Missing, empty, or invalid cmd field; invalid characters in cmd

endpoints.description: CORS preflight — always returns 204 with CORS headers (Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *)

commands.description: Health check. Returns a Pong message.
Full status snapshot. Returns a Status message.
Runtime state flags only (FSD, nag, profile, offset, etc.).
CAN bus clock and health only.
Set nag-killer operating mode string (e.g. aggressive, passive).
Set speed offset to <n> km/h (integer). 0 disables.
Set speed offset to auto-calculate mode.
Enable TLSSC restore (spoof SELF_DRIVING AP tier).
Set MQTT broker hostname or IP.
Set MQTT publish interval in ms (e.g. mqtt:interval:1000).
Enable raw CAN frame listen mode.
Disable raw CAN frame listen mode.
Enable AP injection gate (writes require AP/Park/Summon condition).
Query AP gate state (enabled, ap, park, summon, open).
Spoof region code to <code> (integer). Saved to NVS.
Set CAN oscillator clock profile by name (e.g. canclock:8, canclock:16).
Enable single-shot TX mode on MCP2515.
Override vehicle variant detection (e.g. variant:HW3, variant:HW4, variant:LEGACY).

messages.description: Emitted once at startup after all hardware is initialised.
Full state snapshot. Emitted on demand (status command) or after any command.
CAN bus clock and health only.
Compact status snapshot with reduced payload.
Log message (simple string or log dump).

Bool01.description: Numeric boolean used in serial/BLE output. 0 = false, 1 = true. WiFi uses native JSON boolean.

CommandInput.description: Plain-text command string sent to serial or BLE (newline-terminated). Same vocabulary accepted by WiFi POST /cmd.

WiFiCommand.description: Request body for POST /cmd on the WiFi REST API.

WiFiTpms.description: TPMS pressures (× 100 kPa) and temperatures (°C) for all four wheels.

WiFiPowertrain.description: Basic powertrain snapshot included when hasPowertrain is true.

WiFiWheelSpeeds.description: Wheel speeds × 100 km/h, included when hasWheelSpeeds is true.

WiFiMotorTemps.description: Motor temperatures °C, included when hasMotorTemps is true.

WiFiFeatures.description: Feature availability flags for the detected vehicle variant.

WiFiState.description: Full device state returned by GET /status and POST /cmd on the WiFi REST API. Uses native JSON booleans (unlike serial/BLE which use 0/1).

variant.description: Detected or configured vehicle variant name

CanBusValues.description: Integer value per CAN bus (chassis / vehicle / body).

hzMin.description: Min Hz × 10 per bus observed (0 until first window)
